alt: Placing queens on a board one row at a time. Each step places a queen in the first column not already attacked by an earlier row, or backtracks and removes the previous row's queen when a row has no safe column left. A complete board with one queen per row and no attacks is a solution.

steps.caption: Row 0: place a queen at column 0. The board starts empty.
Row 1: place a queen at column 2. Columns 0, 1 in this row are already attacked.
Backtrack: the queen at row 1, column 2 is removed so the next column can be tried.
